Nonempty history without a verified transition receipt is refused. Cross-database commits are explicitly non-atomic: a durable first-owner receipt allows the interrupted second owner to be completed without replaying seeds. References are removed in finally.

Polling pg_try_advisory_lock ends each wait statement instead of retaining the transaction that could deadlock a concurrent-index build.
